A '''star system''' was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained an average&ndash;sized orange [[Unidentified star (Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quarry)|star]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as well as the [[Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quarry]] [[Comet/Legends|comet]]. The [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Mulako Corporation]] Quarry originated in the formation of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].
